aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_edge.pass: Clean hits build momentum a third faster.
aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_edge.chan: It pierces: it cuts on through a held guard instead of stopping there, through ten foes instead of six, and in a clash it has an edge: a little more time on each beat, and an even struggle is its.
aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_form.pass: Finishers add two fifths more (a player's cap still holds).
aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_form.chan: A finisher opens the nearest creature within five blocks whose stance is half worn or more (never a player or a boss), so a worn-down crowd falls one after another.
aura.wildercord.way_node.blade_sovereign: Each finisher feeds your awakening two seconds instead of one, up to eight.
While you're awakened, Aura Slash costs nothing and is ready again in a second.
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_edge.pa: Your stance takes two fifths less wear, and a hit knocks a third less momentum off you.
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_edge.ch: It covers every side, its perfect moment lasts half again as long, a held guard throws a third of each blow it catches back at the striker, and it turns shots back at whoever loosed them (a little aura each).
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_form.pa: Aura armour takes a third of each blow instead of a quarter, and costs a fifth less.
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_form.ch: It challenges: creatures within its reach that hunt your allies turn on you, and a creature that strikes your raised guard staggers.
aura.wildercord.way_node.bulwark_soverei: While you're awakened nothing breaks your stance and everything a foe deals you is a fifth weaker (less against a player's blows); spent, you aren't slowed.
It's a bastion: a foe's shots crossing into it from outside are turned back at its edge, and the creatures inside are slowed a step more.
aura.wildercord.way_node.shadowstep_edge: Blows and arts that land on a foe from behind wear its stance half again as fast.
A perfect guard against a blow slips you behind whoever struck, facing its back, so your counter falls there.
aura.wildercord.way_node.shadowstep_form: For two seconds after an Aura Step every blow you land counts as from behind.
It leaves an afterimage where you set off that strikes a moment later, cutting every foe beside it.
aura.wildercord.way_node.shadowstep_sove: A finisher landed from behind readies your Aura Step at once.
While you're awakened it costs nothing, is ready again in a second, and its afterimage strikes twice.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_edge.pas: A third of the momentum you build is built by your allied swordsmen near you too.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_edge.cha: Every finisher lets out a rallying cry: you and your allies near you take a sixth less from foes for five seconds, and allied swordsmen build momentum and share half the aura it gave back.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_form.pas: A quarter of the aura you gather flows to your allied swordsmen near you.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_form.cha: While it presses on a foe, you and your allies within its reach take a tenth less from foes.
aura.wildercord.way_node.banner_sovereig: Allied swordsmen near you lose a third less momentum to hits, and your awakening holds their momentum at the second tier while it burns.
It shelters the party: you and your allies inside take a fifth less from foes, your allied swordsmen gather aura there as you do, and their momentum doesn't ebb.

aura.wildercord.technique_part.rising_cu: Up across the foes in front, throwing them into the air.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.falling_c: Overhead and down onto one or two: narrow and heavy, and hard on a stance.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.sweep.des: Wide and level round the front: many foes, a little each.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.spin.desc: A whole turn: every foe round about you.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.draw.desc: A fast level cut out of the sheath: the lightest stroke, and the cheapest. Every blade knows it from Edge.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.on_the_bl: The stroke lands at once, where your blade reaches. Every blade knows it from Edge.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.wave.desc: The stroke thrown on as a crescent of aura flying seven blocks past its reach (a spin's as a ring racing out), a little lighter; a wall stops it.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.burst.des: The stroke's force breaking out all round you at once: lighter, but nobody near is left out.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.afterimag: A lighter stroke now, and an afterimage left standing where you struck it, striking again from there a moment later. The Way of the Shadowstep lends it.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.pierce.de: Through whatever stands in the way: further, and three more foes, a little lighter. The Way of the Blade lends it.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.sunder.de: Wears a stance two and a half times as hard as an art, to open a foe for your finisher.
aura.wildercord.technique_part.bind.desc: Roots each foe it strikes where it stands for a moment (a player only briefly).
aura.wildercord.technique_part.echo.desc: Strikes each foe again a moment later for half as much, wherever it has gone, if it's still near.
